label: 负例：新西兰住房政策调整仅两国报道（2023）
description: 2023年10月12日，新西兰政府公布住房密度政策的调整方案，新西兰主流媒体进行国内报道，仅澳大利亚媒体因两国住房市场关联性做了少量跟进。该事件除首发国外仅获得1个国家（澳大利亚）的报道跟随，不满足“至少3个国家在14天内跟进”的跨国扩散条件（b 条件不满足），不应判定为议程设置事件。文章本身报道同一事件，应归入同一议题，但议程设置判定应为 false。

articles.title: Government unveils overhaul of medium-density housing rules
articles.content: The New Zealand government on Thursday announced significant changes to the medium-density residential standards introduced two years ago. Councils will gain more flexibility over where intensification rules apply. Housing advocates warned the changes could slow the supply of new homes in major cities.

articles.title: Housing density rule changes: what they mean for Auckland suburbs
articles.content: The government's revision of medium-density housing rules will give Auckland Council more discretion over zoning in established suburbs. Property groups welcomed the announcement while urban planners expressed concern about long-term intensification targets. Public consultation on the changes opens next month.

articles.title: New Zealand waters down landmark housing density reforms
articles.content: New Zealand's government has announced it will wind back parts of its bipartisan housing density reforms, a move being watched by Australian cities grappling with their own supply shortages. The changes give local councils more control over where higher-density zoning applies. Australian planning experts say the shift carries lessons for state governments here.

articles.title: New Zealand's housing policy reversal offers lessons for Sydney
articles.content: New Zealand's decision to loosen its medium-density housing standards has drawn attention from Australian policymakers facing similar pressures over urban intensification. Sydney councils are debating comparable zoning changes this year. Analysts note the two countries' housing markets often move in tandem.

articles.title: Opposition criticises housing rule changes as 'policy chaos'
articles.content: New Zealand's opposition parties have criticised the government's changes to medium-density housing rules, calling the shift policy chaos that will undermine investor confidence. The housing minister defended the reforms as giving communities a greater voice. A parliamentary debate on the changes is scheduled for next week.

articles.title: Rugby World Cup: All Blacks prepare for semifinal showdown
articles.content: The All Blacks held their final training session in Paris on Thursday ahead of the Rugby World Cup semifinal. The coaching staff confirmed an unchanged starting lineup. Fans have travelled in large numbers from New Zealand for the match.

articles.title: Sydney Film Festival announces summer program
articles.content: The Sydney Film Festival unveiled its summer program on Friday, featuring premieres from more than 30 countries. Organizers expect strong attendance after last year's record season. Tickets go on sale to the general public next week.

articles.title: Dairy export prices rise at latest global auction
articles.content: Global dairy prices rose for the third consecutive auction this week, with whole milk powder up nearly four percent. Analysts attributed the increase to stronger demand from Southeast Asia. New Zealand farmers welcomed the improvement in farmgate price forecasts.
